title: Undo on the Body screen can fail without a word
what: When the member taps Undo after deleting or replacing a weigh-in or measurement, the bar closes first. If putting the entry back then fails, the error is dropped and nothing tells the member; the entry simply stays gone.
expected: A plain line says the entry could not be put back, and Undo can be tried again.
how_often: rare: only when the phone's database write fails
fix_line: Keep the Undo bar until the undo has worked, and say so when it fails
